Join us for a live performance by Steve Lapointe, pianist-in-residence in the Windgate Foundation Atrium. ABOUT THE MUSICIAN Steve Lapointe’s nine years of classical piano as a youth grounded him in music theory. Jazz studies while in Ithaca, New York, opened his ears to extemporaneous improvisation and the music of Keith Jarrett, Chick Corea, Bill Evans, Michel Petrucciani and the American songbook. item.title: The Morning Read: Small Business Analytics Edition — Mon Aug 31, 9:00 AM
item.description:
AVL Digital Nomads # **Small Business Analytics**
**How does a business make money? Really?** Join us for coffee and a different kind of morning conversation during Asheville Entrepreneurship Week. **Dr. Amanda Bell** of Thrive Strategy Lab will take us inside the numbers behind a small business and show us what they can tell us about how the business actually works. In about 45 minutes, we’ll look at real numbers from real books, read out loud. Think reading tea leaves, except it’s math.
### **What we’ll figure out**
**What the business really earns** Not just the number that goes to the bank.
**The one thing the business sells that everything hangs on** An hour, a job, a ride, a table, a box. Every business has a fundamental unit that drives the economics behind it.
**The cost that quietly eats the profit** The expense that shows up every month, often for years, and can make all the difference. This isn’t an accounting class, a pitch session, or traditional business networking.

item.title: Asheville Crokinole Club — Tue Sep 1, 6:00 PM — Taproom At Highland Brewing Co.
item.description:
Crokinole Tuesdays at Highland Brewing Taproom Join us every Tuesday in the Taproom for an evening of flicks, strategy, and friendly competition! We’re hosting the Asheville Crokinole Club—a community of players who love this classic dexterity board game. Never played? No problem! Crokinole is easy to learn and endlessly fun. Players take turns flicking wooden discs across a circular board, aiming for the high-scoring center zones. The twist? If your opponent has discs on the board, you must hit one—miss, and your piece is out! Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just curious, come grab a pint, meet new friends, and test your skills.
Source: Highland Brewing

item.title: Guided Trail Walk — Sat Sep 12, 10:00 AM
item.description: Hit the trails and learn more about The North Carolina Arboretum’s botanically diverse forest with a guided trail walk! April through October, this free hiking program is led by trained volunteer guides who take small groups of participants along woodland trails and through a variety of forest types. Depending on the season and each guide’s area of expertise, topics of discussion may include wildflowers, plant and tree identification, natural history and more. Guided trail walks are limited to 15 people, including the guide, and are not recommended for guests under 16 years of age. Groups depart from the Baker Visitor Center Lobby on Tuesdays at 1 p.m. and Saturdays at 10 a.m. and 1 p.m.. Walks last 1.5 – 2.5 hours, are approximately one to two miles in length. As this program is held rain or shine, all participants should dress appropriately for the weather. There is no pre-registration; walks are first-come first served and sign up sheets are located in the Baker Visitors Center.

The coffeeshop is located in a strip mall where the Candler YMCA is, and the sonic. The Dripolator is next to the bank, and looks a little like a house. There is usually plenty of parking in the lot out front. If you're having trouble send me a message!

item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina ***\*\*\*Please note: event listings are moving to the Shut Up & Write! website and this Meetup page will be closed in a few weeks. You will find our Tuesday night events here: [https://www.shutupwrite.com/series/id2uT2JS7l00](https://www.shutupwrite.com/series/id2uT2JS7l00)\*\*\****
**Here's how it works.** Show up at or before 6:00. At 6:00, we do some quick introductions. Afterward, for a full 60 minutes (I'll set a timer!) we are heads-down writing. Writing what? A novel? You bet. Some poetry? Sure. Song lyrics? Your resume? That report you need to get to your boss before 8 AM or you'll *need* *to write* that resume? All of the above and more. Just shut up and write.
Surrounding ourselves with other writers who are busy putting words onto page (physical or virtual) keeps us all accountable and focused.

item.description:
PlayYourCourt Asheville Tennis We’re still working to get more people into these Meetups, but our goal is to give PlayYourCourt members a few social tennis outings each week in addition to your practice sessions and Challenge League matches.
These Meetups are co-ed, super laid back, and all skill levels are welcome. Post your skill level and a suggested court in the comments section so we can round up as many players as we can for some tennis fun!
Also, if you’re looking to meet new practice partners or play some matches and you aren’t already in the PlayYourCourt Community, you can go here to see what we’re all about and sign up:
https://www.playyourcourt.com/tennis-community/asheville-nc/meetup/
If you love tennis, we’d love to have you! Be sure and watch the quick video that explains how everything works.
Happy hitting!
- Scott
